data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
KMT Wealth Management's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in OPAD, AHT, and NVA.

NVA filed a notice of late 10-K filing (NT 10-K) on September 29, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1852551/000149315226044708/0001493152-26-044708-index.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only, never issuer-paid. May I send the free weekly issue and discuss a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Best,
Andrew
